description: Deep, expressive American male with real range. Trailer weight when you need it, warm and conversational when you don't. Built for commercials, promos, brand spots, and social ads. Also strong for explainers, documentaries, podcast intros, and VO.

name: The Duke - Gritty Mob Boss
description: A deep, gravelly and commanding character voice packed with raw grit, street-smart charm and mob boss authority with a light German accent. Ideal for video game villains, action heroes, western anti-heroes, dark noir narration, audiobooks, promo and trailers. Studio-ready character voice acting with API integration for immersive projects. Look out for more voices by Alex Vox.

name: Rex Thunder - Deep N Tough
description: Promo voice with raw, intense power, cinematic grit. Perfect for rock and rap concerts, action sports monster truck content, horror movie trailers and attention grabbing high energy radio commercials. American male voice of Hey Its Brad.

description: Promos for News, Top 40, Rock & Alternative. Imaging voice by Hey Its Brad. Movie trailers. Concert and stadium announcements. Friendly fun commercials. Podcast intros or social media advertisements. American male. Use with ElevenLabs companion voice, Guy Serious.

name: Titan - Young Epic Storyteller
description: Utilize the American, raspy yet youthful voice of Titan, a young-adult narrator whose deep, textured tone delivers gripping, edge-of-your-seat storytelling. Titan’s voice is built for suspenseful monologues, cinematic narration, and immersive audio experiences, with a natural grit that resonates in dystopian fiction, sci-fi audiobooks, and dark fantasy universes. The perfect blend of teen bravado and mature depth, Titan excels in trailer voiceovers, gaming content, and story-driven podcasts.

name: Flint - Deep, Raspy, and Warm
description: Ignite your content with Flint, a voice that strikes with precision and leaves a lasting impression. Its deep, raspy resonance embodies strength and determination, while maintaining a smooth undertone that captivates listeners. Perfect for narrations, trailers, or authoritative characters, Flint balances grit and clarity to deliver messages with power and finesse. Forge unforgettable moments with the voice of Flint.

name: K. V. Hagen - Exceptionally Deep Bass
description: A rare, exceptionally deep male voice with a naturally low, effortless bass register. Warm, resonant and commanding, with a calm, measured, hypnotic delivery and natural, unforced depth, clarity and gravitas. Recorded in a professional, acoustically treated studio with a near-silent noise floor. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, documentaries, cinematic storytelling, trailers, meditation, sleep stories, commercials, true crime, history, mythology, poetry, fantasy, sci-fi, gothic fiction & horror.

name: Ed - Late Night Announcer
description: Comedy show introduction voice. Over the top cheesy American male. For live radio audience silly events. Game shows, award shows, parody trailers. Celebrity guest or Saturday sketch club stage intros. Cartoons or animation. A funny vintage character by Hey Its Brad.

name: Hank - Deep and Engaging Narrator
description: Hank's deep, rich voice is reminiscent of famous movie trailer actors like James Earl Jones and Don LaFontaine. His voice is currently one of the top social media voices in the world.

description: This voice delivers a deep, cinematic American male tone designed for villains, dark storytelling, trailers, and dramatic content. His delivery is powerful, gritty, intense, and commanding, making it ideal for movie trailers, horror narration, fantasy worlds, video games, dark characters, monsters, demons, and cinematic storytelling. Perfect for suspense, thriller, action, and gaming projects seeking an immersive deep voice with menace, gravitas, authority, and dramatic impact.

name: Jax Meridian - Rich and Deep Storyteller
description: A rich, velvety voice with a captivating depth, masterfully conveying gravitas and intrigue. Ideal for movie trailers, documentary narration, and sophisticated brand messaging.

Professional male voice featuring a deep, rich, gravelly resonance.

Clear, mature, powerful, serious, confident, executive, masculine, gritty, calm, neutral, impactful, cinematic, inspiring.

name: Shaun - The Ultimate Narrator Voice
description: Need "THE" narrator voice for your project? This is my impression of the greatest and most well-known narrators. This voice is perfect for any voice acting project, from videos to movie trailers.

name: Flavio - Deep & Authoritative
description: Flavio is a commanding, low-pitched voice designed to capture immediate attention. His mature tone blends a rich, gravelly resonance with a calm, deliberate pace. Perfect for audiobooks, thrillers, movie trailers, dramatic documentaries, or premium brand messaging. Flavio projects absolute authority, sophistication, and reassuring strength. Ideal for ElevenLabs tags like: Deep, Authoritative, Narration, Gravelly, Dramatic. This voice gives any audio project maximum impact and texture.

name: Atlas
description: Deep, powerful cinematic announcer voice with commanding authority. Perfect for movie trailers, festivals, sports events, game cinematics, TV promos and epic narration. Delivers a rich low end, dramatic intensity and premium broadcast quality. You may want to add some reverb in post.

name: Caelan - V3 Cinematic Titan
description: Optimized and Engineered for v3. Caelan is a hyper-realistic Middle-Aged powerhouse, boasting massive, Gravelly resonance and a Deep sub-bass floor. With amazing Emotional Range, he excels as a Grizzled, Stoic Sellsword or Rugged Anti-Hero, yet commands the Sinister, Authoritative presence of a Dark Villain. Expertly designed for RPG Lore, Dark Fantasy, Movie Trailers, and Premium Audiobooks. A masterclass in vocal depth and cinematic soul.

name: Jasper Vayne - Epic Grim Dark Narrator
description: Male voice with a deep, resonant tone and a dramatic, commanding presence. Smooth and cool in delivery, with an underlying sinister edge and a subtly sadistic quality.

name: Shardul K - Epic Devotional Narrator
description: Dramatic and deeply calm — Shardul carries the weight of ancient stories without ever rushing them. His voice holds the gravitas of epics and the stillness of prayer. Built for Hindu mythology narration, devotional content, audiobooks, spiritual documentary, and any project where the story demands to be felt before it is understood.

name: Revenant - Young Epic Narrator
description: Bring your stories to life with Revenant — an American voice that’s youthful yet rugged, deep but energetic. With a gritty, cinematic texture, Revenant delivers intense narration that hooks listeners from the start. Whether it's dystopian tales, sci-fi adventures, or dark fantasy epics, his tone adds weight and atmosphere. Ideal for trailers, gaming content, and immersive podcasts, Revenant strikes the perfect balance between bold teen attitude and seasoned storytelling depth.

name: Atlas - Deep, Gravelly Narrator
description: Atlas is a deep, gravelly American male voice built for documentary narration, audiobooks, and cinematic storytelling. Trained across factual scripts, long-form non-fiction, and epic fantasy, his low raspy register carries unhurried authority and natural weight - the sound of someone who has been there.Measured and resonant, built to hold attention for hours. Ideal for documentary, history and nature narration, audiobooks, trailers, and rugged character work.

name: Mani - Deep toned Narrator
description: Mani delivers a commandingly deep, resonant, & authoritative tone, forged through over 40 years of mastery in the voice industry. His weathered, gravelly timbre carries a weight of "lived-in" experience, making him the definitive choice for building tension and atmospheric suspense. Ensuring a grip on the listener that is both haunting and hypnotic. Ideal for true-crime documentaries, high-stakes cinematic trailers, noir-style narrations, and epic thrillers where a sophisticated voice is needed.

name: Luke - Warm and Commanding Narrator
description: A deep, rich, and authoritative narrator voice with a slight or neutral accent. Warm yet commanding, perfect for documentaries, epic storytelling, trailers, and audiobooks. This voice captivates listeners with its steady, engaging presence, ideal for dramatic monologues and immersive narration.

name: Ruhaan – Heroic Mythology Narrator
description: Ruhaan delivers a powerful, clear, & emotionally charged tone designed for epic mythology storytelling. His dramatic delivery adds scale and intensity to grand narratives while maintaining clarity & control. The voice carries heroic presence, making mythological moments feel larger than life & emotionally immersive. Ideal for Ramayana, Mahabharata, Puranic tales, cinematic storytelling, and long-form mythic audio series and devotional streaming apps.

name: Winston – Adventure Fantasy Narrator
description: Winston brings warmth and wonder to fantasy worlds that feel genuinely alive. His rich, immersive delivery builds entire universes from the ground up — from children's fantasy tales and portal world adventures to epic high fantasy sagas. A natural fit for children's audiobook publishers, fantasy fiction creators, middle grade storytellers, worldbuilding content channels, and production studios crafting the next Narnia, Avatar, or His Dark Materials for a new generation of listeners.

name: Indrajeet M - Hindu Mythology Narrator
description: Divine, epic, and legendary — Indrajeet M turns ancient battles and sacred legends into something listeners feel in their chest. His deep, weighted delivery carries every god, demon, and warrior with the gravity the story demands, holding attention scene after scene. Built for full-length audiobook series and devotional scripture readings. Ideal for audiobook studios and devotional content creators.

name: Eric - Trusted Guide
description: Eric is a warm, calm, conversational American male narrator with a reassuring, trustworthy delivery. Clear, articulate, and naturally authoritative, he is an engaging storyteller for documentary narration.

name: Viking Bjorn - Epic Medieval Raider
description: Hear the wind in the fjords in the voice of Ragnar the Viking. Gravelly and deep, it echoes with the strength of the North and the wisdom of a life lived by the axe and the sea. This authoritative Nordic voice is ideal for bringing to life powerful Viking characters, reflective warriors, and captivating narrators in fantasy and historical tales.

name: Eric Puhlmann
description: Male baritone voice (30s), deep, resonant, and natural. Professional audiobook narrator and voiceover artist. Conversational, engaging, and authoritative delivery. Ideal for storytelling, long-form narration, eLearning, documentaries, commercials, and podcast intros. Clear, articulate tone with cinematic, motivational, and educational range.

Great for virtual assistants, thriller documentaries, audiobooks, educational content, explainers, podcasts, social media narration, product walkthroughs, conversational scripts, guided instruction, and content. The voice carries a smooth clear quality, making it a strong fit for epic storytelling, dialogue, digital campaigns, audio book, branded messages, and narrator.

Each syllable is delivered with smooth clarity, creating a tranquil soundscape that instantly puts listeners at ease.

description: A voice imbued with a deep, velvety richness that commands attention and soothes the listener - not only sonorous and authoritative but also carries a charismatic allure, making it perfect for a wide array of projects from immersive audiobooks and engaging advertisements to compelling documentaries and educational content - blends a classical baritone depth with a modern clarity, ideal for bringing narratives to life or lending gravitas to commercial ventures.

description: Deep, warm male voice in the low-baritone/bass range. Measured, steady delivery with clear articulation and natural dynamic range. Documentary, corporate narration, audiobooks, and meditative content.

Best for documentaries, history, mysteries, true crime, investigative YouTube videos, nonfiction audiobooks, podcasts, and long-form storytelling.
